description: The Central Statistics Division of Tuvalu lists its census files in a download category that includes the 2022 census report, the 2017 census tables and report, and the 2012 tables and volume one. The 2017 tables workbook has household tables with a column for each of the nine islands: tenure and land ownership, drinking water source with piping and wells, toilet type and discharge, cooking energy and lighting, solid waste services with a satisfaction rating and council bins, electrical appliances damaged, crops, livestock and fishing, ICT and internet access, and households affected by natural disasters. For example, 849 of 1,626 households were on Funafuti. The 2022 report adds tables on dwelling ownership, construction material, cooking fuel, lighting and toilets by region and internet access by island. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX and PDF, no registration. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: the richest island tables date from 2017, and the census page lists files only through a script, so the download category endpoint was used to see them. Simulation uses: island-level water, waste and disaster impact data for sea level rise and cyclone exposure studies on atolls. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.
